item.subject: science
item.stem: Ananya wants to observe the planet Mars from the roof of her flat in Chennai on a clear, moonless night in December. Mars is above the horizon at 10 p.m. that night, but a tall building to the east blocks part of the sky, and bright streetlights glow nearby. Under which condition will Ananya have the best chance of actually seeing Mars?

options.A: At 10 p.m., looking away from the tall building, after the streetlights are switched off so the sky is dark and the view is open
options.B: At any time during the night, because if Mars exists in the sky it can be seen from any place whenever it is dark
options.C: At 10 p.m., even though thick clouds cover the sky, because the sky still looks black at night
options.D: In the afternoon, because Mars shines brightly enough to be seen during the day from Chennai
